craft_notes: Sthāyin: full oblation posture. Rows: arrange, muse, breathe, stand. Rejected: shortening — killed: posture is the rite. Read aloud: held offering.

lines: Then offered as may be, the ladle-spoon up-down-faced, as might-and-Śiva formed,
musing the stream of supreme nectar fallen, risen in the sky of the twelve-end, risen full-Śiva-moon,
and breathing the vauṣaḍ-ending spell, till ghee's end stand —
l4.sanskrit_cite: tato yathāśakti hutvā sruksruvau ūrdhvādhomukhatayā śaktiśivarūpau parasparonmukhau vidhāya samapādotthito dvādaśāntagaganoditaśivapūrṇacandraniḥsṛtapatatparāmṛtadhārābhāvanāṃ kurvan vauṣaḍantaṃ mantram uccārayan ca ājyakṣayāntaṃ tiṣṭhet iti pūrṇāhutiḥ mantracakrasaṃtarpaṇī
